mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned copper-gold project, northern Vancouver Island, BC (35 km land package, district-scale). 2025 PEA (news Feb 19, 2025; NI 43-101 tech report filed Apr 4, 2025, eff. Feb 12, 2025): staged development — Phase 1 (gold-rich) avg 200,000 oz Au/yr + 48M lbs Cu/yr over 5 yrs at AISC US$1.83/lb CuEq; Phase 2 avg 81M lbs Cu, 123 koz Au, 3M lbs Mo, 5 t Re/yr at AISC US$2.52/lb CuEq; 29-yr LOM payable production 2,168M lbs Cu, 3.9 Moz Au, 66M lbs Mo, 124 t Re at LOM AISC US$2.41/lb CuEq. Base case: after-tax NPV7% C$2.0B (US$1.5B), IRR 29%, 1.9-yr payback; spot: NPV7% C$3.8B (US$2.6B), IRR 45%, 1.4-yr payback. Initial capex US$850M; NPV/capex 1.7. LOM revenue mix: 48% Cu, 45% Au, 7% Mo. 2025 drilling focused on higher-grade northern corridor expansion. No reserves defined (PEA-stage, includes inferred resources). No production.

notes: Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX-V:NCX. President & CEO Sam Lee. All project economics per 2025 PEA (all C$ unless noted). PEA is preliminary in nature and includes inferred resources; no mineral reserves declared.
